messages.subject: coord_trans bug
parts:
Hello List -

I think I found a bug. When using coord_trans, the expand argument for
the scales is currently being ignored.

Example:

## without coord_trans
set.seed(20091975);qplot(rlnorm(100),rlnorm(100))+scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,10),expand=c(0,0))
## with coord_trans
set.seed(20091975);qplot(rlnorm(100),rlnorm(100))+coord_trans(x="log")+scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,10),expand=c(0,0))


R 2.9.0 (OS X 10.5)
ggplot2 R package version 0.8.2


--
Science is the art of the soluble. (Peter Medawar)
